title: Headcount under each manager
hints: A person's headcount is 1 plus the headcounts of their direct reports.
Write a helper that returns one person's count and, as it goes, records that count in a shared dictionary.
Each person is visited exactly once, so this is O(n) even for a deep org.
A person's headcount is 1 plus their direct reports' headcounts.
A recursive helper returns one person's count and records it in a shared map.
